### POST `/api/ReturnsRefunds/GetRefundOptions`

Returns channel-specific information regarding the types of refund that can be applied to the given order Permissions Required: GlobalPermissions.OrderBook.ReturnsRefunds.Refunds.ViewRefundsNode

### POST `/api/ReturnsRefunds/GetActionableRefundHeaders`

Returns a paged list of booked refund headers Permissions Required: GlobalPermissions.OrderBook.ReturnsRefunds.Refunds.ViewRefundsNode

### POST `/api/ReturnsRefunds/GetProcessedOrAckedErrorRefundHeaders`

Returns a paged list of processed or acknowledged error refund headers Permissions Required: GlobalPermissions.OrderBook.ReturnsRefunds.Refunds.ViewRefundsNode

### POST `/api/ReturnsRefunds/GetRMAHeadersByOrderId`

Returns all RMA headers associated with the given order ID Permissions Required: GlobalPermissions.OrderBook.ReturnsRefunds.Refunds.ViewRefundsNode

### POST `/api/ReturnsRefunds/GetRefundHeadersByOrderId`

Returns all refund headers associated with the given order ID Permissions Required: GlobalPermissions.OrderBook.ReturnsRefunds.Refunds.ViewRefundsNode

### POST `/api/ReturnsRefunds/GetRefundLinesByHeaderId`

Returns a refund, given its header ID Permissions Required: GlobalPermissions.OrderBook.ReturnsRefunds.Refunds.ViewRefundsNode

### POST `/api/ReturnsRefunds/CreateRefund`

Creates a refund in the system for approval Permissions Required: GlobalPermissions.OrderBook.ReturnsRefunds.Refunds.CreateRefundsNode

### POST `/api/ReturnsRefunds/UpdateRefund`

Updates an existing refund in the system. Requires create and delete permissions Permissions Required: GlobalPermissions.OrderBook.ReturnsRefunds.Refunds.CreateRefundsNode

### POST `/api/ReturnsRefunds/AcknowledgeRefundErrors`

Acknowledges error responses for a given refund header Permissions Required: GlobalPermissions.OrderBook.ReturnsRefunds.Refunds.ApproveRefundsNode

### POST `/api/ReturnsRefunds/AcknowledgeRMAErrors`

Acknowledges all error responses for a given RMA header Permissions Required: GlobalPermissions.OrderBook.ReturnsRefunds.ReturnsExchanges.AcceptReturnsExchangesNode

### POST `/api/ReturnsRefunds/ActionRefund`

Sends a refund to the channel for actioning Permissions Required: GlobalPermissions.OrderBook.ReturnsRefunds.Refunds.ApproveRefundsNode

### POST `/api/ReturnsRefunds/DeleteRefund`

Deletes all lines from the given refund header that have not yet been processed, or acknowledged as errors, removing it from the "Actionable Refunds" screen. If no lines are left, the header row is deleted Permissions Required: GlobalPermissions.OrderBook.ReturnsRefunds.Refunds.DeleteRefundsNode

### POST `/api/ReturnsRefunds/DeleteRMA`

Deletes all lines from the given RMA header that have not yet been processed, or acknowledged as errors, removing it from the "RMA Bookings" screen. If no lines are left, the header row is deleted Permissions Required: GlobalPermissions.OrderBook.ReturnsRefunds.ReturnsExchanges.DeleteReturnsExchangesNode

### POST `/api/ReturnsRefunds/UpdateRMABooking`

### POST `/api/ReturnsRefunds/ActionRMABooking`
